inj.note: Franklin was disciplined by the league for allegedly spitting at an opponent late in the fourth quarter of the Bills' Week 6 win over the Raiders. The decision has been altered to a fine, and with the Bills on a bye, the Temple product will be available for Week 8 against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 1.

news.h: Bills' Sam Franklin ready to play this week after suspension reduced to fine
news.d: Bills DB and special teams captain Sam Franklin Jr., doesn't want to fixate on the incident that briefly landed him a suspension that was later reduced to a fine upon appeal.

news.h: Bills' Sam Franklin wins appeal; suspension for spitting reduced to fine
news.d: Bills safety and special teams captain Sam Franklin Jr., has won his appeal to overturn the one-game suspension for supposedly spitting at an opponent in the win over the Raiders.

news.h: Bills' Sam Franklin suspended one game for spitting; appealing, per sources
news.d: Bills defensive back Sam Franklin Jr. was suspended one game for unsportsmanlike conduct that the league said was a spitting incident against the Raiders.
